author: cellish
body:
Hi there! 
I made a new map that I call "Atlantis" hope you like it :) <3
Right here, I allow ppls to make the same map for different gamemodes (TDM, CTW, KoTH etc)
Anyways, give me ur skype in the comments if you want to ask me anything :)

Players: 10v10/12v12/15v15 
New Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/dd5x3sr4bb9j0c1/Sam7.rar
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/qsXOX
XML: done {tag=1c898c77b0cc474a8ce4b5521f2b18e7} made it

Teams: Sharks Vs Watermen (Blue Vs Seagrass-Green)

Please tell me about things that I could add, and things I could make better and stuff. Thanks!
I got alot of feedback on its original look, and I've been changing the map alot!

Dont forget to check out my youtube channel!
https://m.youtube.com/channel/UCFFlJ2FwShkBFNEEMeSmq6w

-Sam

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
I love the block palette you came up with, very original and it looks great

As for the actual map the 3 islands make a huge difference and imo they're a great addition. The amount of void seems perfect and the only worry I have is the positioning of the monument. You could push the two side islands on each side outwards a little to make ground pushing somewhat easier but we can see if that's needed in the testing.

Great job!
